# azion_workload_deployment (Resource)

Resource for managing Azion Workload Deployments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "azion_workload_deployment" "example" {
  workload_id = 12345

  deployment {
    name    = "My Deployment"
    current = true
    active  = true

    strategy {
      type = "default"
      attributes {
        application = 67890
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workload_id` (Number) The workload identifier.

### Optional

- `deployment` (Block, Optional) The deployment configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--deployment))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource (workloadID/deploymentID format).
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last Terraform update of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import azion_workload_deployment.example 12345/67890
```
